index_character: Calculus topic index links derivative, epsilon-delta limits, antiderivatives, integrals and function definitions to specific chapter sections
source_observation: The open book index explicitly routes 'antiderivative' to §4.10, 'derivative' to §3.1, 'epsilon-delta definition of the limit' to §2.5 and 'definite integral' to §5.2. These are index pointers, not yet independently inspected definition text.
new_research_route: Use named textbook index links to independently read exact accessible section definitions, recording hypotheses, definitions and source links. Respect the per-source license record rather than inferring permission from public access.

source_observation: The Algebra subject index directly exposed topic sections including Field Theory and Homological Algebra, and linked to alphabetical index and other broad mathematical areas; exact definition entries were not exhaustively checked.
